Maya Rao: Postmortem uploaded for yesterday's outage (registry + vendor auth cascade): https://redwood/internal/postmortems/1975001111. Need concrete follow-ups: owners, timelines, and recurring checks. Short root cause: vendor auth rotation spike + our fallback env var typo prevented registry fallback.

Tom Becker: I'll take registry hardening: local model cache with TTL, circuit-breaker, and a staging canary to validate fallback. Plan: design doc 1975002200, PR by 1975004300, staging canary 1975005400.

Leah Nguyen: I'll own auth provider mitigations: token-rotation monitoring, short-lived fallback tokens, and vendor retry/backoff tuning. ETA: alerts 1 week (1975006911), fallback token flow 2 weeks (1975010511). Need vendor test keys.

Ibrahim Al-Karim: I'll update runbooks, add vendor escalation contacts, and run a tabletop. Tabletop scheduled for 1975003600. I'll also add a checklist for triage steps when auth errors spike.

Maya Rao: Ops-bot, please create tracker items grouped under PM-6211 and tag infra + security.

ops-bot: Created PM-6211-1 (registry-cache + circuit-breaker) owner=Tom Becker due=1975005400; PM-6211-2 (auth-token monitoring + fallback) owner=Leah Nguyen due=1975010511; PM-6211-3 (runbook + tabletop) owner=Ibrahim Al-Karim due=1975003600. Links: https://tasks.redwood/PM-6211..3 :white_check_mark:

Carlos Vega: Recommend adding a recurring monthly vendor SLA audit to PM-6211-2 and a quarterly tabletop to PM-6211-3. Also suggest an automated smoke test that validates registry fallback each deploy.

Tom Becker: Agree on smoke test. Will add a job that flips the registry endpoint to a stub in staging and asserts fallback within 30s. Adding canary run to PR timeline.

Leah Nguyen: Blocker: vendor keys for staging tenant. @Maya can you escalate to the vendor CSM? We can't test fallback without a test tenant.

Maya Rao: Escalated to vendor account rep + CSM; ticket link https://support.vendor/t/xyz-321. Expect keys in 48 hours.

Ibrahim Al-Karim: Tabletop invite sent to #eng + #eng-sre for 1975003600. Deck uploaded to the postmortem doc.

Tom Becker: Pushing initial PR draft: https://git.redwood/repo/registry/fix123  please review @leah @ibrahim. Marking the PR as high-priority.

Leah Nguyen: I'll prepare alert queries for token expiry spikes and a dashboard panel. ETA for alerts + dashboard: 1975004200.

Maya Rao: Summary to add to postmortem doc (please confirm):
- Registry fallback + cache (Tom) 1975005400 -> staging canary; 1975008400 -> prod behind flag
- Auth monitoring + fallback tokens (Leah) 197506911 -> alerts; 1975010511 -> fallback flow deployed
- Runbook/tabletop (Ibrahim) 197503600 -> tabletop completed
- Vendor SLA audit (Carlos + Leah) 197509000 -> recurring task added
Reply if any ETA needs adjustment.

Tom Becker: Confirmed. Only risk is review backlog.

Leah Nguyen: Confirmed. Blocker depends on vendor keys arrival.

Carlos Vega: I'll add the smoke-test job to the CI board and coordinate infra quota for canaries.

Maya Rao: Thanks all. Let's reconvene in 72 hours for a status update in this thread. If something blocks earlier, ping me or @ops-oncall. :hammer_and_wrench:
